ev.q: SOURCE: Pleis JR, Lucas JW, Ward BW. Summary health statistics for U.S. adults: National Health Interview Survey, 2008.
In 2008, 61.5% of U.S. adults had excellent or very good health.
Figure description: The figure shows the percentage of adults 18 years or older reported to have excellent or very good health, by race

methods_quotes.q: Estimates were age adjusted using the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population
